final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), name_averages AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(average_points) AS name_average FROM race_averages GROUP BY race_name) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.race_name, ra.average_points, ra.result_count, ra.average_points / NULLIF(na.name_average, 0) AS ratio FROM race_averages AS ra JOIN name_averages AS na ON na.race_name = ra.race_name ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
